thread:
Maya: Quick async standup. Yesterday: finalized the canary rollout doc and merged the spec PR (https://git.redwood/v2/specs#123). Blockers: waiting on infra to confirm dedicated pool sizing for launch. Today: prioritize QA checklist and smoke tests. @Jon can you check CI flakiness?
Jon: On it. Yesterday: did CR on /api/routing and pushed fixes. Blocker: flaky e2e failing with timeout on the batcher path. I added extra retries locally. Today: will add timeout logs and re-run CI. PR #4123.
Priya: Yesterday: updated pricing calc and started the billing dashboard prototype. Blocker: need representative telemetry to validate model-unit costs. Maya, can you share a sample request distribution when you have a sec?
Maya: Yes — I'll drop a small csv in the shared drive and ping you in ~10m.
Eric: Reproduced the e2e timeout locally; root cause looks like an edge-case in continuous batching with short sequences. Small fix ready, opened PR #4130. Plan to push to canary after green.
Sam: QA: started staging smoke and saw a tokenization mismatch for quantized model on dedicated. Filing a bug as ISSUE-289. Not blocking launch yet.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: model-v2 -> 11:30 PST, traffic=5% (us-west, eu-west). Will post results in 30m.
Jon: Quick prioritization question — do we focus on e2e flakiness (blocks canary) or the pricing dashboard (important but not blocking)? My vote: e2e first.
Maya: Agree — e2e > pricing for this sprint. Priya, please deprioritize billing visuals until canary is stable; help with telemetry sampling instead.
Priya: OK, deprioritizing dashboard. I'll work with Maya on the sample and then help QA.
Eric: Merging PR #4130 in ~15m, will comment here once it's live.
Sam: After merge I'll re-run the smoke suite and report back.
Maya: Thanks. Blockers recap: infra sizing (waiting), CI flakiness tracked by Jon/Eric, tokenization bug tracked by Sam. If anyone needs me I'll be in async-design. Short sync same time tomorrow. :thumbsup:
